log: 'Idle-page activity: its own fresh FLUX.1 Krea [dev] fake on 7958. With each polling surface open, and its reads failing, nothing the page sends by itself counts as use (keep-awake, idle release), recorded by /api/fake/activity'

eval: window.__until = async (test, ms = 20000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { if (await test()) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return false; }; window.__activity = async (reset = false) => (await fetch('/api/fake/activity', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({reset})})).json(); window.__seen = (record, prefix) => record.requests.filter((entry) => entry.request.startsWith(prefix)).length; window.__paths = (record) => [...new Set(record.requests.map((entry) => entry.request))];

log: 'The page load and its first reads are use: the recorder counts what the server would'

expect: (async () => { const record = await __activity(true); return record.counted.includes('GET /') && record.counted.some((request) => request.startsWith('GET /api/')); })()

log: 'The bundles dialog open, automatic backup shown: its status reads every 3 s are the page\'s own'

expect: (async () => { const record = await __activity(true); window.__bundles = record; return __seen(record, 'GET /api/gallery/bundles/status') >= 2 && __seen(record, 'GET /api/gallery/automatic-backup') >= 2 && __seen(record, 'GET /api/status') >= 2; })()

log: 'Models open; its pictures strip and its cache facts fail after the server answered: each asks again on the status poll (the strip every 5 s, the facts every 3 s)'

eval: window.__api = api; window.api = (path, ...rest) => { const p = String(path); const fails = p.startsWith('/api/models') || (p.startsWith('/api/gallery?') && p.includes('model=')); return fails ? __api(path, ...rest).then(() => { throw new Error('fake failure after the server answered'); }) : __api(path, ...rest); }; syncModelShots({fresh: true});

expect: (async () => { const record = await __activity(true); window.__strip = record; return __seen(record, 'GET /api/models') >= 2 && __seen(record, 'GET /api/gallery') >= 1 && __seen(record, 'GET /api/status') >= 3; })()

log: 'The catalogue fails: the picker asks again 10 s on while it is open, the page\'s own timer too'

expect: (async () => { const record = await __activity(true); window.__catalogue = record; return __seen(record, 'GET /api/models') >= 1 && __seen(record, 'GET /api/status') >= 4; })()
